question: How long may sweet cake and rice dish remain before becoming offered remains?
premises: Sweet cake and rice dish are mentioned as offerings.
A time limit is given as half a yāma.
The instruction is addressed to the great goddess.
inference: Sweet cake and rice dish become nirmālya after half a yāma.
uncertainties: The continuation of the rule may depend on surrounding verses.
plain_english: O great goddess, sweet cake and rice dish become offered remains after half a watch.
